channel.title: Nolan Kido Notes
channel.description: Occasional notes on tools, decisions, and learning.

item.title: A working tool is not the same as a trustworthy one.
item.description: A useful distinction between a convincing demonstration and evidence that a tool can be relied on.

item.title: Good decisions, imperfect outcomes.
item.description: A practical way to separate the quality of a decision from the result of a single uncertain outcome.

item.title: Learning something difficult from the beginning.
item.description: Start with a concrete capability, identify the missing foundations, and make progress visible through practice.
